ja: 1/1000スケールで 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2199』の艦船をコレクション！
1/1000スケールプラモデル ポルメリア級強襲航宙母艦 親衛隊カラーが登場！
『宇宙戦艦ヤマト２１９９』より、航宙親衛艦隊所属のポルメリア級強襲航宙母艦を１／１０００スケールプラモデルで商品化。
● 親衛艦隊所属艦の濃紺の設定カラーを成形色で再現し、艦底下部の発光部はピンクのクリアパーツで再現。（※商品は発光しません）
● 劇中シーン再現に欠かせない、親衛隊カラーのメカコレサイズのメランカが１機と、１／１０００スケールサイズのメランカが２機付属。
● １／１０００ ポルメリア級強襲航宙母艦と、メカコレサイズのメランカには、専用の台座が付属。

en: Collect ships from "Space Battleship Yamato 2199" in 1/1000 Scale!
1/1000 Scale plastic model Polmeria class assault aircraft carrier SS color is now available!
From "Space Battleship Yamato 2199", the Polmeria class assault spacecraft carrier belonging to the Aerospace Guard fleet is commercialized as a 1/1000 scale plastic model.

- The dark blue setting color of the ship belonging to the Guard Fleet is reproduced with molded color, and the light emitting part at the bottom of the ship is reproduced with pink clear parts. (*The product does not emit light)
● Includes one Mechakore-sized Melanka in SS colors and two 1/1000 Scale Melankas, which are essential for reproducing scenes from the movie.
● The 1/1000 Polmeria class assault spacecraft carrier and the mechanical collection size Melanka come with special pedestals.
[Kit size]
・ 1/1000 Polmeria class assault aircraft carrier Total length approximately 384mm
・ Mecha collection size combat support aircraft DWG229 Melanka Overall width approximately 170mm
・ 1/1000 combat support aircraft DWG229 Melanka Overall width approximately 11mm
1/1000 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS
・Use adhesive for the assembly (*There are adhesive points for detailed parts)
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
[About sales price]
*Due to the consumption tax increase, the tax rate for products shipped after 20144 will be 8%.
